label: copy phase: about to output x / i / h / l (mostly early recall)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99% of mass), on steps whose output token is x, i, h or l (out_tok lift 12-15x for each, about 92% of mass together; 1 and v add a little). It is strongest at recall_idx 2-4 (t around 10-12), weak at recall_idx 0-1 and fades late in long sequences. It is nearly silent in the original phase and at <DEL>. Precision is low (about 0.18-0.23): most copy steps that output x/i/h/l do not cross threshold. Whether a step fires seems to depend on the input/output pair in a way no simple variable captures (for example i->x and n->i fire strongly, b->x does not). Restricting in_tok or recall position raised precision only slightly and cost recall.
